# Keerthi Group of Companies — Keerthi Agencies
> Direct Wholesale Hardware, TMT Steel, Building Materials, Electrical & Plumbing Distribution in Kerala, India.

## Business Overview
- **Legal Entity**: Keerthi Group of Companies
- **Trading Name**: Keerthi Agencies
- **Domain**: https://keerthigroup.co.in
- **Headquarters**: Athikkayam Bus Stand Opposite, Near SBI Bank, Athikkayam, Pathanamthitta, Kerala - 689711, India
- **GSTIN**: 32AFOPA9652D1ZM
- **Phone**: +91 7907524465 / +91 9744342697
- **Primary Email**: keerthiagkm@gmail.com
- **Core Operations**: Retail, wholesale, and direct manufacturer distribution of TMT steel rebar, cement, roofing sheets, CPVC/UPVC/SWR plumbing pipes, FRLS copper electrical wires, switchgear, power backups, and heavy construction hardware across Kerala.

## Key Product Categories & Direct Distribution
- **TMT Steel Rebar**: Primary distributor of Tata Tiscon Fe500D & Fe550D Super Ductile TMT bars conforming to IS 1786:2008.
- **Plumbing Systems**: Authorized distribution of Supreme, Astral, and K-FLOW CPVC (ASTM D2846), UPVC (ASTM D1785), and SWR drainage systems.
- **Electrical Wires & Cables**: Direct distribution of Polycab, Havells, V-Guard, and K-ELECTRA 99.97% pure electrolytic copper FRLS wires conforming to IS 694.
- **Roofing Solutions**: PPGL/PPGI AZ150 Galvalume color-coated trapezoidal & tile-profile sheets with AS 3566 Class 4 K-FIX self-drilling fasteners.
- **Waterproofing & Admixtures**: IS 2645 integral waterproofing, SBR polymer latex, crystalline pore-blocking agents, and PCE superplasticizers from Dr. Fixit, Fosroc, and Sika.
- **Hardware & Fasteners**: K-FIX industrial screws, wall plugs, anchor bolts, door hardware, and power tools.

## Technical Knowledge Base (Keerthi Insights)
- [Selecting TMT Steel Grades (Fe500D vs Fe550D) for Kerala Structures](https://keerthigroup.co.in/blog/how-to-choose-the-right-tmt-steel-kerala): Engineering analysis of IS 1786 rebar, yield strength, UTS/YS ratio, ductility %, and CRS corrosion resistance.
- [CPVC vs UPVC vs SWR Pipe Hydraulics & Material Properties](https://keerthigroup.co.in/blog/cpvc-vs-upvc-vs-pvc-plumbing-pipes-guide): Complete fluid dynamics, ASTM D2846 SDR ratings, solvent welding chemistry, and hydrostatic pressure testing.
- [Electrical Wire Conductor Sizing, FRLS Insulation & Breaker Selection](https://keerthigroup.co.in/blog/electrical-wiring-safety-checklist-building-kerala): IS 694 copper sizing, FRLS oxygen index, voltage drop formulas, MCB B/C/D curves, and 30mA RCCB shock safety.
- [Roofing Sheet Engineering: Galvalume Coatings, Purlin Spacing & Screws](https://keerthigroup.co.in/blog/selecting-best-roofing-sheets-kerala-monsoon): AZ150 zinc-aluminum coating mass, purlin span calculations, wind uplift resistance, and Class 4 EPDM fasteners.
- [Concrete Waterproofing & Admixture Chemistry](https://keerthigroup.co.in/blog/concrete-waterproofing-admixtures-technical-guide): IS 2645 integral compounds, crystalline pore blocking, SBR latex vs acrylic polymers, and PCE superplasticizers.
